status: source-based mechanism; binary-level trace not performed

sources.finding: FontBase::buildTextBlob constructs positional glyph runs from glyph IDs and advances; it does not attach original UTF-8 text or cluster mapping.
internalDrawGlyphRun can emit ActualText when cluster source text is supplied; otherwise font glyph-to-Unicode mapping is the fallback.
Both Type0 and Type3 generation use glyphToUnicode for ToUnicode. Font type alone does not prove or exclude faithful Unicode extraction.

inference: Loss of original text before Skia PDF emission plausibly explains font cmap aliases and unmapped substituted/combined glyphs. Actual PDF maps and font cmap inspection are needed to connect individual failures.
unsafeWorkaroundsRejected: NFKC-normalizing extracted text is not a PDF repair and cannot restore omitted characters.
Blind replacement of ToUnicode aliases cannot distinguish original compatibility characters from equivalent CJK characters sharing one glyph.
Changing fonts does not by itself supply the missing original text/cluster information; any mitigation must be validated and reported as partial.
next: Native agent inspects actual PDF maps and bounded feature/font experiments; implementation remains failed for text copy/search until a real fix is proved.
